observations.title: Map of Saskatchewan Showing Completed Watershed Plans
observations.role: Amisk and Cumberland generalized identities and a complete branching-feature naming-scope assessment
observations.observation: The complete map shows the first two target outlines within waters labelled Amisk Lake and Cumberland Lake. The branching feature at Stanley Mission is visible, but Otter Lake is printed west of much of it and supplies no clear name partition. Multiple regional views count as one publication. The printed production date differs from the URL date directory.

included_evidence_limit: Included files contain factual observations, bibliography and selected public-domain geometry. Original publications and inspection materials are omitted. Public validation checks only included facts and coordinates; it cannot reproduce omitted visual source judgments or resolve the remaining naming-scope hold.
